certificates_check.name: certificates_check
certificates_check.value: (status = 'In Progress'::text) OR ((issued_at IS NOT NULL) AND (credential_id IS NOT NULL) AND (grade IS NOT NULL))

evaluations_check.name: evaluations_check
evaluations_check.value: ((status = 'draft'::text) OR (evaluated_at IS NOT NULL)) AND ((status <> 'released'::text) OR (released_at IS NOT NULL))

quiz_attempts_check.name: quiz_attempts_check
quiz_attempts_check.value: ((submitted_at IS NULL) AND (score IS NULL) AND (pct IS NULL) AND (passed IS NULL)) OR ((submitted_at IS NOT NULL) AND (score IS NOT NULL) AND (max_score IS NOT NULL) AND (pct IS NOT NULL) AND (passed IS NOT NULL) AND (time_taken_seconds IS NOT NULL))

reevaluation_requests_check.name: reevaluation_requests_check
reevaluation_requests_check.value: ((status = ANY (ARRAY['Pending'::text, 'In Review'::text])) AND (resolved_at IS NULL) AND (revised_score IS NULL)) OR ((status = 'Upheld'::text) AND (resolved_at IS NOT NULL) AND (resolution IS NOT NULL) AND (revised_score IS NULL)) OR ((status = 'Revised'::text) AND (resolved_at IS NOT NULL) AND (resolution IS NOT NULL) AND (revised_score IS NOT NULL))
